sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-12 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea.
No data tools were available when this review was written, so no depths, dates, hole sizes, durations or volumes are stated here.
Any figures for this wellbore should be taken from the field's daily drilling reports and the well summary once they have been checked against the source data.
The section-by-section hole sizes, depths and drilling rates for 15/9-F-12 are not reported in this review and need to be pulled from the well's section records.
Casing shoe depths and the new hole drilled in each section should be confirmed against the same records before the sections are compared with the planned well design.
The split of activity time between productive drilling and lost time for 15/9-F-12 is not quantified here.
A proper review of lost time needs the coded activity log, sorted by primary and possible lost-time tiers, so that the main causes of delay can be identified by category and subcategory.
The review should be completed by adding the verified totals for activity hours, lost hours, report counts and the drilling campaign timeline for 15/9-F-12.
Real-time curve statistics were not used and should not be cited from this document.
